thread:
sarah_support: Customer C-3412 reported invoice spike — billed tokens 12,014 for 2026-03-10 but dashboard 'served tokens' ~2,341. They attached sample request IDs. Can someone triage?

john_oncall: Thanks Sarah. Can you paste one of the request IDs and the invoice line item id?

sarah_support: request_id=req_8a3f2c, invoice_line=inv_20260310_77. They also included a replay trace showing prefetch activity.

anita_billing: Pulling invoice now. inv_20260310_77 shows a bulk charge labeled "prefetch_tokens" — internal code path: continuous-batcher prefetch.

matt_sre: That's a hint. Are they on continuous-batching + prefix-KV caching? Prefetch warmups can generate served tokens that are billed if prefetch runs as a separate RPC.

rosa_product: Customer said they use our SDK default with streaming + continuousBatcher enabled. They didn't explicitly disable prefetch.

john_oncall: Can you share the small snippet of their logs? The trace around req_8a3f2c should show whether prefetch requests were deduped or billed separately.

sarah_support: Paste from them: "[INFO] prefetch hit warmup: batch_id=cb-44 prefetch_req=req_8a3f2c_pref token_cost=3620"

matt_sre: That token_cost number aligns: billed ~12k could be prefetch (3.6k) + two more prefetch windows + user-served ~2.3k => sum ~12k. Suggests prefetch was counted on invoice.

anita_billing: Confirmed invoice lines: three prefetch events at 3,620 / 2,990 / 2,384 + served tokens 2,020 = 11,014 + small rounding/embedding ops => ~12,014.

rosa_product: Ok — we need to explain to customer why prefetch shows up on invoice but not on the served-tokens dashboard view they looked at.

john_oncall: Root cause likely dashboard filter: "served tokens" excludes prefetch RPCs (we only surface tokens associated with final user-visible responses). Billing counts all metered RPCs including background prefetch and KV warmups.

matt_sre: Repro checklist for support:
- ask customer to run a short period with continuousBatcher disabled (SDK flag: continuousBatcher=false)
- collect request IDs for that window
- compare invoice lines and dashboard served tokens
- share trace for a single request with prefetch fields

sarah_support: I sent the repro steps to C-3412 and asked for a short test window tomorrow morning. Also offered a pro-rated credit while we investigate.

anita_billing: I'll prepare a line-item map we can attach to the ticket: timestamped invoice rows mapped to internal meter ids (prefetch_kv, cb_warmup, user_response). That should make the delta explicit.

rosa_product: Can we add a small note in the dashboard UI explaining that "served tokens" excludes background prefetch and warmup RPCs which are billed? Could reduce future confusion. Filing a quick follow-up.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy: dashboard-copy-update (staging) — will include tooltip text.

metrics-bot: FYI metrics: last 7d prefetch token fraction increased after cb rollout v2 on 2026-03-08. prefetch_fraction=0.18 -> 0.35 for some customers.

john_oncall: Action items: (1) Provide customer with invoice line map (Anita). (2) Run repro with continuousBatcher off (Sarah + customer). (3) If repro confirms, provide one-time credit and update docs/UI (Rosa + Billing + Docs). I'll follow up after customer test.

sarah_support: Thanks team. I'll keep thread updated when customer sends results. :thumbsup:

matt_sre: Quick note for engineering: we should consider emitting a separate meter tag for prefetch that is exposed in the billing export so customers can reconcile automatically (meter tagging ticket created).

rosa_product: Agree. Adding to roadmap for "billing-reconability".

sarah_support: Customer replied: running test now, sent new request IDs — will paste after window completes.

anita_billing: Logged the potential credit as pending until repro confirms.

john_oncall: Closing loop once the repro confirms. If anyone hits blockers, ping me.

sarah_support: Update 2026-03-11 09:45 UTC — customer test done. They observed billed tokens drop to match dashboard when continuousBatcher disabled. Will share final acceptance for the credit.

rosa_product: Great. Let's draft the customer explanation: short blurb + link to doc and note about opt-out flag for continuousBatcher.

sarah_support: Draft sent to customer. They accepted the explanation and credit. Ticket resolved. :white_check_mark:
